features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.desc: You copy Conjuration spells in half the time and for half the gold.

features.name: Minor Conjuration
features.desc: As an action, you create a nonliving object (up to 3 feet, 10 lb.) for 1 hour.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you teleport up to 30 feet or swap places with a willing creature.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.desc: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Conjuration spells.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.desc: Creatures summoned by your Conjuration spells gain +30 to their Hit Point maximum.
